subtitle: Digital Sustainability Companion

lake.alt: A quiet mountain lake reflecting the landscape

paragraphs: Our digital lives leave a footprint. Every file we save, video we stream, and device we use depends on energy and resources. Yet the impact of these everyday moments often stays out of sight. The Digital Sustainability Companion explores how we can make that connection visible, understandable, and useful.

We are developing a thoughtful companion that helps people reflect on their digital habits and discover practical opportunities for change. By bringing research, design, and technology together, the project aims to turn a complex subject into small, meaningful decisions. Less unnecessary storage. More considered consumption. A longer life for the devices we already own. A lighter digital future, shaped one choice at a time.
